claude_proposed_widenings.name: ModifyRollAdvantageOperation (new OngoingOperation variant)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Foresight grants the target advantage on all D20 Tests for the duration. OngoingOperation only offers roll_modifier (numeric DiceDelta) and damage_on_hit. No variant can express advantage/disadvantage as an ongoing spell operation. The v4 atom modify_roll_advantage exists but is unreachable from OngoingOperation.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: the target has Advantage on D20 Tests

claude_proposed_widenings.name: "ability_check" in RollKind
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: D20 Tests in SRD 5.2.1 covers attack rolls, saving throws, AND ability checks. RollKind only has 'attack_roll' | 'saving_throw'. Foresight's advantage applies to all three categories; RollKind must be widened.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: the target has Advantage on D20 Tests

claude_proposed_widenings.name: Incoming roll modifier scope for OngoingOperation
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Foresight imposes disadvantage on attack rolls made BY OTHER CREATURES against the target. No current OngoingOperation variant expresses this 'incoming' scope — all existing modifiers act on rolls made by the target or caster, not rolls made targeting the creature. A new operation variant (e.g., impose_roll_disadvantage_on_incoming) or a scope discriminant on a combined advantage operation is needed.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: other creatures have Disadvantage on attack rolls against it
